title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 18 in G-sharp minor

character.text: Double fugue with a separate exposition for each subject, then both combined

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from subject 2. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 37–44). Returns in Episode 11 (bars 107–110). Returns in Episode 12 (bars 115–124).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times). Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 17–18) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, a fourth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 65–66).

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 9–12) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from subject 2, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 3 (bars 37–44) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 7 (bars 70–71). Returns in Episode 9 (bars 83–96). Returns in Episode 14 (bars 139–142).

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 6 (bars 65–66) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 6 (bars 65–66) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the bass's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from subject 2 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from subject 2 (3 times). Bass: a figure from subject 2 (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a fifth every bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in G♯ minor (Bass); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 10
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in D♯ minor (Soprano); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 11
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 17–18) in part, in the same voices, a third higher. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a sixth every bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in E major (Alto); Subject 2 (Soprano)
Episode 12
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 17–18) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: the opening of subject 2 and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and the opening of subject 2 and a figure from the subject and a figure from subject 2, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in G♯ minor (Alto); Subject 2 (Bass)
Episode 13
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in G♯ minor (Soprano); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 14
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 6 (bars 65–66) in part, with soprano and bass exchanged, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from subject 2, inverted and a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 49–54).
